articles.title: Champagne, No Hangover
articles.dek: We followed every champion in four leagues into the season after the parade. They come back to earth. In the NBA and NHL, and probably the NFL, they don’t fall as far as anybody else that good.
articles.byline: A Deep Bag investigation · October 2026 356 champions, 352 followed into the next season · 7,785 team-seasons · 1903–2026

articles.title: The Fresh-Start Myth
articles.dek: We tracked two decades of NFL trades against players who stayed put. A change of scenery mostly isn't associated with a different player. What predicts the outcome is the job waiting on the other end.
articles.byline: A Deep Bag investigation · 243 trades analyzed, of 1,222 reviewed · 2002–2025

articles.title: Payback Is a Rounding Error
articles.dek: Every revenge game gets its own pregame segment. We scored 1,547 of them. The payback is about a third of a fantasy point, about the same as playing at home.
articles.byline: A Deep Bag investigation · 1,547 NFL revenge games, 2001–2025 · 13,559 more in the NBA

articles.title: The Cliff
articles.dek: Running backs go over it at 29. Receivers and NBA players get a year or two more, hockey skaters three to five. We rebuilt the aging curves for 14 position groups in four leagues, correcting for every player who quietly washed out of the data.
articles.byline: A Deep Bag investigation · 78,055 player-seasons · NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL October 2026
